Heard on Stay Application, IA No.1 of 
2025
The applicant seeks transfer of Case 
No.566 of 2025, Sameer Tyagi Vs. Megha 
Vohra Tyagi, pending in the court of 1st
Additional Principal Judge, Roorkee, 
District Haridwar to the court of Principal 
Judge, Family Court, Dehradun.
Having considered, as an interim 
measure, till the next date of listing, the 
proceedings of the court below shall remain 
in abeyance.
Stay application stands disposed of, 
accordingly.
